title: GHG & Sustainability Consultant
description:
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a motivated
  
  
GHG & Sustainability Consultant
  
  
to join our growing team. This role is suitable for candidates who are passionate about sustainability, climate action, carbon management, and energy efficiency, including entry-level candidates who are eager to build a long-term career in the industry.
  
  
As a one-stop carbon-neutral technology service provider, we work closely with large manufacturers and industrial clients on greenhouse gas accounting, carbon verification, energy-related projects, decarbonisation strategies, and sustainability solutions. The successful candidate will gain hands-on exposure to real-world carbon and energy projects, supported by structured internal training and a strong network of external experts.
  
  
This is a good opportunity for someone who wants to grow together with a startup and develop practical expertise in the fast-evolving sustainability and carbon services sector.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Support greenhouse gas accounting, carbon footprint, carbon inventory, and sustainability-related projects for corporate and industrial clients.
  
  
Assist in data collection, data analysis, emissions calculation, and preparation of technical reports.
  
  
Support GHG verification, validation, and assurance-related assignments in accordance with relevant standards and client requirements.
  
  
Conduct research on sustainability regulations, carbon markets, energy efficiency, decarbonisation technologies, and ESG-related topics.
  
  
Assist in energy audit, emissions reduction, and low-carbon solution projects where required.
  
  
Prepare client deliverables, including presentations, reports, calculation files, and supporting documentation.
  
  
Communicate with clients to collect information, clarify project requirements, and support project implementation.
  
  
Work with internal team members and external technical experts to deliver high-quality project outcomes.
  
  
Stay updated on relevant sustainability standards, frameworks, and regulations.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Sustainability, Energy, Climate Change, Business, Economics, or a related discipline.
  
  
Entry-level candidates are welcome to apply. Prior internship or project experience in sustainability, ESG, GHG accounting, energy, or environmental consulting will be an advantage.
  
  
Strong interest in sustainability, climate change, carbon management, and the low-carbon transition.
  
  
Good analytical skills and attention to detail, especially when working with data and calculations.
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  
  
Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Mandarin or other regional language skills will be an advantage.
  
  
Willingness to learn technical standards, methodologies, and industry practices.
  
  
Self-motivated, responsible, and comfortable working in a startup environment.
  
  
Able to work independently while also collaborating effectively with team members and external experts.
  
  
Passionate about building a career in the sustainability and carbon services industry.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
Hands-on experience with large manufacturers and industrial clients.
  
  
Exposure to practical carbon, energy, and sustainability projects.
  
  
Structured training and mentorship for entry-level candidates.
  
  
Support from an experienced internal team and strong external expert network.
  
  
Opportunities to grow quickly with the company in a fast-developing industry.
  
  
A collaborative startup environment where your contribution can make a visible impact.
  
  
Career development opportunities in GHG accounting, carbon verification, energy management, ESG, and decarbonisation advisory.
  
  
As a carbon technology solution provider with multiple patents, BST is now based in Singapore and is committed to offering technical research and development support for the entire industry chain in the pursuit of carbon neutrality goals. BST actively aligns with the United Nations' 17 Sustainable Development Goals and initiatives like the Singapore Green Plan 2030. This involves enhancing our scientific research capacities across the Asia-Pacific region and globally, advancing cutting-edge low-carbon technologies, providing carbon asset audit/management services, generating premium job prospects and new business avenues for clients, and collaboratively shaping a greener, more sustainable future.

title: Environmental Control Officer
description:
**Job Description:**  
Carry out weekly inspections and submit findings and remedial actions with photographs to the Engineer fortnightly.
  
  
Monitor environmental control measures, including dust, noise, waste management, water pollution control, erosion and sediment control, vector control, and housekeeping.
  
  
Liaise and coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, government authorities (MOM, NEA, etc.), and other stakeholders on environmental matters.
  
  
Monitor and verify that the Environmental Management Plan (EMP) is adhered to at all times and taking action if the specifications are not followed.
  
  
Monitor and verify that environmental impacts are kept to a minimum during the planning and design and construction phases of the project.
  
  
Conduct surveillance, monthly inspections and detailed audits.
  
  
Compile and complete checklists in order to aid the surveillance and inspection requirements.
  
  
Keep records of all activities/incidents concerning the environment on site and issuing of spot fines for transgression of activities identified in the EMP.
  
  
Recommend the issuing of penalties to the Engineers Representative for contravention of the EMP.
  
  
Prepare and submit a Site Environmental Control Programme and Site Environmental Control
  
  
Reports to the Occupier of the construction site.
  
  
Identify environmental issues and recommend measures to rectify the irregularities.
  
  
Prepare and submit a Site Environmental Control Report to the Occupier of the construction site.
  
  
Assist the authorities to investigate environmental issues.
  
  
Organise campaigns, training courses and other activities to develop and sustain the interest of workers in maintaining good environmental health standards.
  
  
**Requirements:**  
Valid Environmental Control Officer (ECO) Certificate with NEA.
  
  
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in road and vehicular underpass/flyover structure construction preferred.

description:
Team and role overview
  
  
The Infrastructure & Climate team invests across essential infrastructure sectors including energy, transport, logistics and utilities through a combination of direct infrastructure equity investments, infrastructure and climate funds, and strategic co-investments. In Southeast Asia, the team is focused on supporting sustainable infrastructure development, accelerating the energy transition, and building climate resilience across key markets including Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Thailand.
  
  
Based in Singapore, the Southeast Asia team plays a central role in delivering BII's regional Infrastructure & Climate strategy, working closely with colleagues across Asia and London to identify, originate, execute and actively manage investments that deliver both strong commercial returns and measurable development impact. The team combines local market expertise with BII's global investment platform, leveraging deep relationships with developers, operators, financial sponsors, commercial banks, DFIs and other strategic partners across the region.
  
  
Over the coming years, the team will be responsible for deploying across existing and new equity platforms, building scalable businesses that support sustainable economic growth and climate objectives in the region. As the platform continues to expand, the team will play an increasingly important role in shaping BII's presence in Southeast Asia while contributing insights, expertise and collaboration across the wider Infrastructure & Climate business, including the growing equity platforms portfolio in India.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Business Development
  
  
Originate investment opportunities utilising your own and BII’s relationships with clients, MDBs, DFIs and commercial banks in co-operation with BII’s wider Infrastructure and Climate teams.
  
  
Contribute to market-mapping exercises across the infrastructure space.
  
  
Assist in developing targeted origination strategies to focus our investment into sectors and geographies where we have natural advantage and where our capital is needed most.
  
  
Monitor development in relation to political, regulatory, business, utility finances, etc. that could impact current and future business in southeast Asia.
  
  
Support Deal transactions
  
  
Support engaging with the Client and other lenders as required to ensure smooth delivery of the transaction.
  
  
Support specific due diligence work streams, such as legal, model audit, technical, environmental & social and insurance, working with external lenders advisors.
  
  
Assume responsibility for the completing of discrete due diligence tasks such as company, industry and economic analysis.
  
  
**Assist in leading and co-ordinating the analysis on :** market, borrower, sponsor(s) and macro-economic variables. Prepare/ review the project financial model.
  
  
Identify transactions risks and assist in developing mitigation structures.
  
  
Take responsibility for deal completion related work including managing conditions precedents to ensure efficient and timely financial close.
  
  
Review and comment on legal documentation together with the internal legal team.
  
  
Assist in structuring and negotiation of terms with Borrowers and co-lenders appropriate to commercially acceptable standards, ensuring legal documentation that is best of class.
  
  
Coordinate and assist in preparing and presenting high-quality investment proposals through BII's investment process as well as the preparation and presenting monitoring papers for existing deals.
  
  
Inclusively manage the engagement of support teams (Environmental, Social, Business Integrity and Development Impact), ensuring all internal stakeholders can achieve their objectives.
  
  
Deal Execution & Portfolio Monitoring
  
  
Assist in delivering a high quality, diversified portfolio of transactions in the region.
  
  
Ensure the maintenance of a high-quality portfolio post-disbursement including financials, development impact and environmental, social and business integrity, leveraging internal specialists as needed.
  
  
Apply appropriate portfolio monitoring processes that include managing the process with more junior team members on assigned deals for the preparation of periodic monitoring reports for BII’s investment committee, checking for early warning signals, reviewing of waiver requests and amendments, and thereby present recommendations for BII’s investment committee or as required to comply with relevant regulations.
  
  
Contribute to Strategic and Other Internal Initiatives
  
  
Work with the other investment teams in I&C including Direct Private Equity, Private Equity Funds and Project Finance teams to collaboratively steer the business growth development and monitoring in accordance with strategic objectives.
  
  
Contribute to other ad hoc internal initiatives, strategic or otherwise.
  
  
The candidate
  
  
**Successful candidates will have a proven track record in:**  
Deep network in Southeast Asia across banks, DFIs and sustainable infrastructure businesses built through previous infrastructure transaction experience in energy, water, ports, or transport, preferably with an international bank; Development Financial Institution or Multilateral Development Institution;
  
  
Originating, structuring, and closing smaller transactions as deal lead or supporting deal lead on larger scale complex transactions;
  
  
Ability to work on multiple opportunities across sectors while working to deadlines and managing time effectively.
  
  
As a member of a small team, a proactive "hands-on" and self-driven approach is important, as well as the ability to mentor junior team members.
  
  
MBA or Master's degree in a relevant field, is advantageous but not a prerequisite.
  
  
**We will be considering the following as important:**  

* Excellent financial analysis and structuring skills;
* Strong understanding of diligence processes, financial terms, legal terms;
* Knowledge of Equity, Funds and Debt investing, including an understanding of market practice in emerging market economies;
* Good business communication skills, written, verbal and presentation;

Candidates should be strongly motivated by BII’s development mission and ideally demonstrate some commitment to development or social goals through previous executive or non-executive activity.
